topics.title: Noriega Arrest and Family Drama Fallout
topics.summary: On October 23rd, former Panamanian dictator Manuel Noriega attempted to jump from a bridge following revelations about his wife’s involvement in a child shooting and insurance fraud. Subsequently, he demanded amenities while hidden within the Cuban Embassy, prompting investigations into drug dealing by his brother who provided information after witnessing the crime; meanwhile, Charles Stewart died 17 days later due to complications stemming from the initial incident.

topics.title: Noriega, Carter & Jesus
topics.summary: During the broadcast, Howard discusses Manuel Noriega’s involvement in Panama and his declared war with America alongside criticism of Jimmy Carter's role. The conversation shifts to depictions of Jesus Christ as attractive figures, followed by a letter criticizing Fartman’s commentary on Nicaragua and an alleged assault case involving a babysitter.

topics.title: FCC Complaint & Shaving Mishap
topics.summary: Radio host Gary discusses a bizarre FCC complaint about Fartman’s policies in Nicaragua, followed by an anecdote of attempting to shave his wife with potashua and resulting razor bumps. He then details the challenges of recording shows via CD due to potential tape mishaps.

topics.title: Poda Swat Pageant Chaos and Real Estate Dreams
topics.summary: During a radio show segment, callers discuss bizarre events including a letter to the FCC about Noriega and a beauty pageant featuring Jackie who won ‘Miss Poda Swat’ after appearing in a commercial. They then delve into real estate advice for Robin, exploring potential homes in Long Island with varying levels of desirability – from East Meadow to Bayville - while grappling with local community quirks.

topics.title: Jealousy and Urine Tests
topics.summary: The program centers around a man’s intense jealousy of his ex-girlfriend's new relationship, expressed through bizarre comments and attempts to sabotage her. He engages in absurd behavior like trying to ‘rape’ someone and devising a scheme involving colored water for urine tests, ultimately revealing an obsession with Joe Piscopo’s girlfriend.

topics.title: Gary’s UN Misadventure
topics.summary: During the broadcast, Howard recounts his encounter with Gary and a young woman at the United Nations. The situation becomes increasingly confusing as Gary appears to be involved in secretive activities with Bill Cates while seemingly uninterested in pursuing romantic interest. Later, the show shifts to discussing Vinnie Matio’s urine test and Ed McMahon promoting mattress sales.
